title.zh: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor
title.en: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor

current_state.zh: At its DevDay keynote, OpenAI announced Dots, an always-on agentic AI assistant that works across connected apps in the background and is powered by the new GPT-6 Astra model, taking aim at Meta's Muse.
current_state.en: At its DevDay keynote, OpenAI announced Dots, an always-on agentic AI assistant that works across connected apps in the background and is powered by the new GPT-6 Astra model, taking aim at Meta's Muse.
